With edge 0->2 removed, edge 1->2 is the only route into node 2 besides nothing else, so a conv there carries more of the load.
Upgrading 1x1 to 3x3 is an incremental gain, smaller than replacing a pool, skip or none.
Convs on parallel branches into node 3 are partly substitutes, so a second 3x3 conv saturates.
A shallow direct conv adds little once the deeper branch through node 2 already has a conv.
A 1x1 conv on the parallel direct branch already provides much of the conv benefit at node 3.
With the direct edge 3 absent, edge 4 is a primary input to node 3, so a strong op matters more.
The direct skip is a valuable gradient and feature path, so swapping it for a conv gains less than replacing weaker ops.
Node 2 reaches the output only via edge 5, so with it removed a conv on edge 0->2 is largely dead.
Removing edge 4 leaves node 1 only the longer route via node 2, so a conv on edge 0->1 has less influence on the output.
